pratap-group.name: Pratap Group
pratap-group.logo: Light and dark SVG logos are on Drive.
pratap-group.imagery: Gradient at 90 degrees between green and azure.
pratap-group.about: Telecom, infrastructure and industrial group. The brand rules on this page start here.

telecrats.name: Telecrats India

colors.name: Telecrats Blue (working)
colors.role: Primary. Check against the master logo.

colors.name: Orange
colors.role: Accent in shapes only, one highlight per slide. Hex not set.

telecrats.logo: SVGs on Drive: navy one colour, reversed white, full colour.
telecrats.tagline: We keep India connected. (approved for a carousel closing slide)
telecrats.layout: Blue on white with lots of white.
telecrats.about: Telecom tower and optical fibre operations and maintenance, installation and commissioning, and solar-site upkeep. Serves operators, ISPs, government and SMBs.

beckhaul.name: Beckhaul Technologies
beckhaul.about: Optical fibre backhaul for operators and public networks, from rollout to making fibre earn.

corsis.name: Corsis Technologies
corsis.logo: Logo JPEG and CDR zip on Drive.
corsis.about: Optical fibre cables for telecom networks.

pals.name: PALS
pals.about: Pratap Academy of Learning Sciences. Training aimed at the telecom talent gap.

ductel.name: Ductel

colors.name: Teal
colors.role: Highlight. Never as text on white or Mist.

colors.name: Cyan
colors.role: Highlight. Never as text on white or Mist.

colors.name: Plum
colors.role: Highlight. Teal, cyan and plum together stay under about 15% of the canvas.

ductel.logo: Signature row: logo alone at left. Carousels add "Swipe" with triple chevron at right.
ductel.imagery: Clean isometric or flat technical illustration. No stock people. No text inside illustrations.
ductel.layout: 4:5, 1080x1350. Section label top left in slate caps, counter top right, headline under the label, illustration centre, supporting line, thin teal rule, signature row. Gradient only for highlight bars and the closing slide.
ductel.about: Protective ducts for fibre and power cables: PLB HDPE, microduct, aerial and tracer duct. Made in Pithampur, Madhya Pradesh.

voltters.name: Voltters

colors.name: Voltters Teal
colors.role: Under about 10% of the canvas. Never as text on light backgrounds.

colors.name: Logo Teal
colors.role: Chevron mark only. Use the logo file.

colors.name: Mist White
colors.role: Text. Secondary text is Mist White at about 65% opacity.

voltters.imagery: Isometric 3D night scenes in the navy range. The lavender-to-violet storage panel look is not Voltters.
voltters.layout: Same 4:5 template as Ductel, with teal section label and rule.
voltters.about: EV battery packs, charge control units, EV chargers and battery energy storage. Made in Pithampur, Madhya Pradesh.

rules.text: The signature is the company logo alone. Never write "a Pratap Group company".
Never alter the logo. Use only the official palette.

isometric-flat.name: Isometric / flat technical
isometric-flat.description: Clean isometric or flat technical illustration on a light background. No stock people. No text inside the illustration.

isometric-night.name: Isometric 3D night scene
isometric-night.description: Isometric 3D scenes in the navy range, lit like a night-time engineering blueprint. Avoid the lavender-to-violet panel look.

clean-white-minimal.name: Clean white minimal
clean-white-minimal.description: Brand blue on white with lots of empty space. Orange appears only in shapes, one highlight per slide.

festival-3d.name: Festival 3D depth
festival-3d.description: For festival greetings: very little text, the logo colours plus one complementary accent, some 3D or depth. Must show what the company does and look different from other companies' creatives.
